autoSync.label: Automatic sync
autoSync.hint: Runs only while {{product}} is open. When you open {{product}} or come back to it and the last full sync is as old as your choice above, it syncs everything, the same as pressing Sync; Canvas may record that as your activity in each course. In between, it only refreshes your course list, deadlines and announcements, without opening any course.

empty.title: No sources yet
empty.description: Add your course folder, your calendar feed or Canvas, and {{product}} will keep a copy of your courses on this computer.

card.feedPrivate: Private feed address (stored in your keychain)

problem.title: The last sync didn't work
problem.expiredCanvas: Your Canvas token has expired or was revoked. Create a new one in Canvas (Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token) and replace it here.
problem.expiredFeed: The calendar no longer accepts this feed address. Copy the address again from your LMS and replace it here.

technical.title: Technical details
technical.note: The original message, for a bug report.

replace.descriptionToken: Create a new token in Canvas (Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token) and paste it here. {{label}} and its courses stay as they are.
replace.descriptionFeed: Copy the calendar feed address again from your LMS and paste it here. {{label}} and its events stay as they are.
replace.requiredFeed: Paste the new feed address first.

description.folder: This removes the source and everything synced from it: its courses, and your AI-policy and term settings for those courses. The files in your folder aren't touched.
description.canvas: This removes the source and everything synced from it: its courses, the course files you downloaded, your AI-policy and term settings for those courses, and its stored access token. Nothing in Canvas changes.
description.ical: This removes the source, the deadlines and events synced from it, and its stored feed address. Your courses aren't affected, and your LMS calendar doesn't change.

addDialog.title: Add a source
addDialog.description: Your new source starts syncing as soon as it's added.
addDialog.doneLater: Source added. It will be included in the next sync.

folderFeed.title: Course folder + calendar feed
folderFeed.description: Your course files on this computer plus your LMS calendar. Works at any school, and it's fine to recommend to classmates.

canvas.title: Canvas access token
canvas.description: Syncs straight from Canvas with a token you create for yourself.

folderFeed.folderHint: Pick the folder that holds one sub-folder per course. Week folders inside a course (like “Week 3”) help {{product}} tell which week it is.
folderFeed.termStartHint: Helps work out the current week.
folderFeed.nameHint: What {{product}} calls this folder. Leave it empty to use the folder's own name.
folderFeed.feedHint: Brings in your deadlines and class times.
folderFeed.feedWhere: Canvas: Calendar → Calendar Feed. Other LMSs: look for 'export calendar' / iCal.
folderFeed.feedPrivate: This address is private — {{product}} stores it in your system keychain.
folderFeed.missing: Choose a folder or paste a calendar feed address — or both.

canvasForm.shareHint: Helping classmates set up? Point them to the course folder + calendar feed option instead.
canvasForm.autoSync: {{product}} syncs by itself while it's open. You can turn that off on Sources & sync.
canvasForm.urlHint: The address you open Canvas at in your browser — just the address, not a link to a course.
canvasForm.httpWarning: Canvas addresses use https. Check that yours starts with https://.
canvasForm.tokenHowTo: In Canvas: Account → Settings → Approved Integrations → + New Access Token. Fill in the purpose (e.g. 'personal study planner, read-only') and pick an expiry date. Copy the token right away — Canvas shows it only once.
canvasForm.noTokenButton: If you don't see this button, your school has turned off student tokens — use Course folder + calendar feed instead.
canvasForm.tokenPrivate: {{product}} checks the token with Canvas, then stores it in your system keychain.

folder.not_found: We couldn't find that folder. Choose it again or check the path.
folder.network: Couldn't read that folder. If it's on a network drive, check that it's connected.
folder.auth: {{product}} isn't allowed to read that folder. Check its permissions.

feed.invalid: That doesn't look like a calendar feed address. Paste the full address, starting with https:// or webcal://.
feed.not_found: Nothing was found at that address. Copy the feed address from your LMS again.
feed.network: Couldn't reach that address. Check your internet connection and try again.
feed.auth: The calendar rejected this address. It may have been reset — copy a fresh one from your LMS.

canvas.invalid: Check the Canvas address and the token.
canvas.not_found: There's no Canvas at that address. Compare it with the address bar when you open Canvas.
canvas.network: Couldn't reach that Canvas address. Check the address and your internet connection.
canvas.auth: Canvas didn't accept this token. It may have expired or been revoked — create a new one and try again.

token.invalid: That doesn't look like a Canvas access token. Copy it again from Canvas and paste it here.
token.not_found: Canvas can no longer be found at this source's address. Remove the source and add it again with the current address.
token.network: Couldn't reach Canvas. Check your internet connection and try again.
token.auth: Canvas didn't accept this token. It may have expired or been revoked — create a new one and try again.
